definitions.explanation: The time period shortly after midday, roughly from 12:00 to 2:00 PM. Indicates the time has just passed noon.

examples.japanese: {昼過|ひるす}ぎ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{届|とど}きます→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: It will arrive in the early afternoon.

examples.japanese: {昼過|ひるす}ぎ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}り{始|はじ}めた→降り始める：22638_furihajimeru⟧。
examples.english: It started raining in the early afternoon.

examples.japanese: {昼過|ひるす}ぎ⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{寝|ね}て→寝る：00470_neru⟧しまって、⟦{午後|ごご}→午後：00544_gogo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遅|おく}れ→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧そうになった。
examples.english: I slept until early afternoon and nearly missed my afternoon plans.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of ⟦{昼|ひる}→昼：00540_hiru⟧ (noon, midday) + ⟦{過|す}ぎ→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧ (past, after). Refers specifically to the time just after noon, roughly 12:00-2:00 PM. Part of a common pattern for expressing approximate times: ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧ (morning), ⟦{昼|ひる}→昼：00540_hiru⟧ (noon), {昼過|ひるす}ぎ (early afternoon), ⟦{夕方|ゆうがた}→夕方：01010_yuugata⟧ (evening), ⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧ (night).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {昼過|ひるす}ぎ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: in the early afternoon
- {昼過|ひるす}ぎ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: from early afternoon
- {昼過|ひるす}ぎ⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧: until early afternoon

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{午後|ごご}→午後：00544_gogo⟧: afternoon (formal, precise)
- ⟦{昼|ひる}→昼：00540_hiru⟧: noon, midday
- ⟦{夕方|ゆうがた}→夕方：01010_yuugata⟧: evening, late afternoon
